corroboration.note: be.brussels lists 38 free-admission museums with per-venue conditions. Broadly consistent, with discrepancies: (1) be.brussels lists Fin de Siecle Museum and Royal Museums of Fine Arts as free first Wednesday from 1pm - brusselsmuseums.be names Magritte Museum and Old Masters Museum individually but not Fin de Siecle; (2) be.brussels says the Sewer Museum is free only via first-Saturday guided tours, while brusselsmuseums.be lists it under free first Sunday; (3) be.brussels lists Espace photographique Contretype as free first Sunday 1-6pm, while brusselsmuseums.be tags Contretype always-free; (4) be.brussels includes venues absent from the brusselsmuseums.be article, e.g. Museum of local history of Evere (Wednesdays + first Sunday), Librarium, National Bank Museum, Wiertz/Meunier museums (weekday always-free); (5) be.brussels' ULB Museum of Medicine entry is consistent with first-Sunday but brusselsmuseums.be also tags it always-free in the search listing.

ghent.note: Both Ghent schemes are restricted to residents of Ghent (gedomicilieerd/domiciled in postcodes 9000 t.e.m. 9052). Late Donderdag: first Thursday of the month, museums open until 22:00; admission is free from 17:30 for Ghent residents only (children/youth <=18 are free for everyone as general policy). First Sunday of the month: free for Ghent residents only. No Late Donderdag in July/August (summer break).

lastWednesday.note: The free last Wednesday of the month for all visitors was abolished as of 1 September 2021. Official quote (City of Antwerp press release, 17/09/2020): 'De gratis toegang op de laatste woensdag van de maand voor alle bezoekers verdwijnt. Inwoners van Antwerpen met een A-kaart krijgen vanaf september 2021 elke eerste dinsdag van de maand gratis toegang tot de permanente en de tijdelijke tentoonstellingen.' The MAS page given as target (https://mas.be/nl/activiteit/laatste-woensdag-van-de-maand) now returns 403/404 ('Geen toegang / Pagina niet gevonden'); its only Wayback capture is from Sep 2020. Current corroboration: DIVA tickets page (2026) confirms first-Tuesday free entry for Antwerp A-kaart holders.
